LanguageData.MiliraXian_BackStoryChild_Mingyuan_BS1.d: [PAWN_nameDef] was born on a Milira colony world that had endured for 130,000 years, into an elite noble family. Her childhood education was strict and systematic: knowledge, combat, etiquette, administration, and survival experience were all treated as ordinary lessons.\n\nThat upbringing made few fields feel unfamiliar to her, and taught her early that peace is often only a thin and fragile surface.
LanguageData.MiliraXian_BackStoryAdult_Mingyuan_BS1.d: An unknown archotech intelligence once dragged [PAWN_nameDef]'s homeworld into another dimension and created war-beasts there, forcing the planet's living things into endless slaughter. In those years she refuses to remember, she learned to burn herself: otherworldly flame scorched her material body and accelerated the release of life energy, pushing her functions toward their limit.\n\nShe later escaped by burning open a path through space. After returning to Kalido, she followed the Milira seeking Ji and longed for quiet. The aftereffects of war did not fade. Unable to stop pursuing power, she eventually left her people to wander alone, carrying a stark creed: grow stronger, or die here.
